Name: Coffee Config
Author: x7eventy7
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/BLupZwo.png[/img]﻿
[font=Tahoma][size=4]Allows you to fully customize the effects from Coffee, Triple Shot Espresso, and Joja Cola including energy gained, health gained, speed boost level and speed boost duration! Whether you want a subtle vanilla-plus experience or dramatically overpowered drinks that turns you into a speed demon, this mod has you covered. The default settings round the vanilla values for speed boost duration up by one minute, but you can easily adjust these using generic mod config menu. 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/wbISYFz.png[/img]﻿
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4]1. Install the latest version of [i]"[b]SMAPI﻿"[/b][/i][b][i], "Content Patcher" ,[font=Tahoma][size=4][font=Tahoma][size=4][b][i] "SpaceCore"[/i][/b][/size][/font][/size][/font] & "[font=Tahoma][size=4][b][i]GMCM[/i][/b][/size][/font]"[/i][/b][/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4]
2. Download this mod and unzip it into [i][b]"Stardew Valley/Mods"[/b][/i]
3. Run the game using [i][b]"SMAPI"[/b][/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rgYlcA5.png[/img]﻿
[b][b][b][b][b][b][b]1.6.0+ on Linux, Mac, and Windows[/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b]
[font=Tahoma][size=4]- Support for Mod Config Menu[/size][/font]

[/size][/font][center][font=Tahoma][size=3][b][i]Please submit any issues, feedback or suggestions. It helps me improve the mod immensely![/i][/b][/size][/font][/center][/size][/font]
